shared_elements: low relief carving on a stone surface
repeated row of similar motifs along the top
justification: Both are low-relief compositions with figures in profile organized against a horizontal band, and each has a row of repeated similar motifs along the upper edge, but that is essentially all they share. A shows a narrative human scene — helmeted archers, a wheeled siege machine and a crenellated walled gate — in a detailed, proportioned manner, while B shows isolated schematic animals (a crouching quadruped, a snake-like creature, a large bird with outspread element) with no humans, no architecture and no narrative action.
